Response to Jennifer Carroll post:  First thing on lease is : "What is being stored?" In looking at the unit to be rented the man (boyfriend?) who was to store the ATV stated, oh it was deep enough to get the ATV in it. At which time he was asked about a title & insurance. ..something to prove ownership, of which he stated he had & would bring back when coming to rent the unit. He even let his driver's license be copied so the lease could be started & save time for his returning later. The only person questioning our policy was Ms. Carroll. Having worked this business long enough to have the drama of husbands & wives, boyfriends & girlfriends owning "titled" property together & splitting ways & one trying to hide something from the other...yes, when we are able to do so, we proactively make sure all owners know that their share of such property is going to be at our site. No one ever implied that "he" had stolen anything. For info, he returned the next day to rent a storage unit (did not say he had been in the day before) & that day the Manager was working & when he gave her his ID she recognized his name from the notes from the day before & the partially filled in lease. So she asked did he bring in the title.  At which time he stated he did not have a title but had a bill of sale (but not with him) & was just a small piece of paper.  The Manager told him she would not be able to rent a unit to him because he still did not have any kind of ownership document but that he might could check with some of the other businesses that did care about this.  Draw what you will from this but it would appear he was coming in to rent a unit as if he had never been there before...don't you think?  Most businesses have rules/policies for a reason & this was one of those examples of why they do.  Yes we do share names, phone numbers, & overview of the daily happenings with each other (good or bad) so their are no surprises for the person working the next day.  This business has been open for 17 + years & a large percentage of our customers are repeats.  We want our customers' property to be safe & secure & strive for that--without any drama!

We have been using AAS for several years now and we appreciate the fact that they look out for our property and the price hasn't gone up in 8 years. They will give you one month free if you pay for 5. They protect themselves by requesting titles and proof of insurance which lets me know that the other people storing here are honest. Thank you AAS for taking such good care of our RV!

I found space here for my extra boxes, etc., when I moved to the area last year. The price is reasonable and the place is well kept. If I could leave a negative star I would. I rented a storage unit from them for an extended period of time. I went to upgrade to a bigger unit only to discover in the two week time frame I had not been to my unit had been broken into and thousands of dollars worth of items stolen. To top it off I spoke with the person in the office who said he had walked by my unit about a week prior to me discovering this and noticed the lock was gone. He opened the unit an item fell out, broke, and he then shoved it back in and carried on. No one called to tell me the item broke or they my lock was gone they just went about their day like nothing had happened, but hey they got their rent from me every month. They also have signs saying “your being watched” on the ends of the units. Truth be told they have one camera which watches the drive in and nothing else! Your items aren’t safe here and the signs give false hope that if something does happen they have your back. The staff was less than helpful or even regretful that the incident had occurred. I will never rent anything from them again whether it be a storage unit or piece of equipment. Despicable service and giving the false hope of security makes it worst. I have filed a report with the Sheriff’s Office but I know there is no hope when it comes to getting my items back. My understanding is their tool rental side has several drivers who appear to be less than trustworthy which leads me to believe this may have employees who knew routines and camera placement for the one camera that kinda faces the units. When I reported my incident to the office they told me they had received several complaints that were similar to mine but did not seemed concerned nor did they alert anyone!!  Take your business elsewhere!!!!!

reviews.text: My wife and her parents and brother are 30 plus year members of the Orange community. My mother in law is a retired school teacher and my father in law worked many years as a deputy sheriff for Orange co. After marrying my wife and having out first child in 2014 we rented a local apartment. We moved out in June of 2016 to help my parents care for my grandmother and my brother. We rented a large unit and stored all of out furniture given to us by my parents as a wedding gift. Very nice stuff that totaled $8500 new and was only used 18 months in our apartment. In addition to our furniture and mattresses my wife had collected dozens of very expensive Longaberger baskets and very expensive when serving dishes and bowls. Most importantly she stored all of our older 2 daughters pictures, first dresses and bronzed shoes. Things that are priceless and irreplaceable to loving parents.  We paid our $100 diligently for42 months!! One month in 2017 my wife went to get a car seat for our newborn and the unit was padlocked. After realizing a mistake was made the owner called to apologize. I accepted and that's that. He was aware that we had small children and that we were long time customers. Unfortunately in 2019 my wife and I suffered many devastating financial setbacks along with my serious medical problems. We knew we were going to get behind on our unit payment and I called and left several voicemails explaining the situation. After six months in January of 2020 I called several time trying to get the manager to return my call so I could set up 2 payment to catch us up. After several calls I was finally sent an email telling me that it had been a while since we had paid AND THATCOUR UNIT HAD BEEN SOLD AND NEW CUSTOMERS WERE LEASSING. i was very upset and repeatedly asked for an explanation but have yet to receive any response. I understand that its abusiness and that there is a possibility that the fine print indicates that after a certain amount of time they can sell our stuff. However this MANAGER AND THE OWNER knew that we were a hard working loving family and that we had been experiencing some financial hardship. NOT ONE PHONE CALL,EMAIL ORCTEXT WAS SENT TO US GIVING US AN OPPORTUNITY TO CATCH UP THE PAYMENTS. NOT 1!!!! So conservatively $15,00  worth of our things were auction off or i believe essentially stolen. A family member or friend of ownership or management recognized the value of the stored items and everything was essentially stolen from us.I absolutely would not make an accusation like that if I didnt believe it in my heart. Why else would we not be called, text or emailed even though the manager and owner knew of us well and we had been doing business with em for 42 MONTHS!! What's the old saying...if it walks like a duck...quacks like a duck...then its....  This is a small town. This owner claims to be a Godly family man. I say if that's the case then call me and we can work out how you're going to pay us back so that we dont have the additional burden of having  to pay for all new furniture and bedroom suits, mattresses and kitchenware and utensils. Or at the VERY least call me and explain why after knowing us and our circumstances not to mention we had rented from you for 42 months why not a single attempt was made to reach us so that we could pay the money and catch up. By the way we have used your services on 3 occasions to get our cars repaired as well. I've never written anything close to a review for anything regarding any topic. However I believe that the fine people of the Orange community and my 5 yr old daughter and 2 yr old son along with our two oldest daughters deserve to hear this and to know who did it. Explain to them that as long as your customers pay on time then God loves them and they are deserving of Grace but when hard times fall on good people then it's time to kick them while their down. It's ok to take advantage of people when they cant pay.. I truly feel this way in this circumstance. You knew who we were but still didnt contact us. Cowardly in my opinion.
Friendly staff, easy 24 hr. access, clean, cheapest in Orange!

reviews.text: There apparently are several levels of management for this place. I rented a storage unit but never was granted access back in February due to an ice storm. I was told three days after I initially rented it that I would get a refund, since I needed a place quickly, (we had just sold one of our rental houses) and so rented  elsewhere.  After 4 tries over several months, and threatening to bring fraud charges, I finally got one today. I don’t know whether it’s the city center storage management or the company they used to handle questions. I think it should be clear that there’s no office on site as far as I can tell . Everyone I talk to is very nice but somewhere along the way communication broke down. There never was a question in anybody’s mind whether I was do a refund either. So I can only assume that if problems came up the same process would occur if for instance there was water damage or something else I can only assume it would take the same amount of time to resolve that. It should be clear that I never actually even occupied a unit there, so don’t know how it would  be to actually store things there.

I would highly recommend NOT renting at this storage facility.  My storage unit was broken into during November, 2017.  There was someone systematically breaking into units looking for valuable goods, then replacing a cheap lock on the unit so people do not notice.  Luckily my unit was full of items that could not be easily transported or moved, despite the fact they were valued at $10k.    found my cut lock inside the unit after using a hacksaw to saw off a different lock.  No surprise this is happening though, because the owners, Building Management Company, had done nothing to keep up the property.  I have photos from the same day/time period of live wires hanging inside of my storage unit, broken glass throughout the access roads, a pile of empty beer bottles, trash, a half-open raw steak, and four lights that were out just near my unit.  Not to mention, there were NO security cameras, and No fences around the property.  After my ordeal of spending 3 hours involving the police, cutting off a different lock, spending $10 on a hacksaw, and losing my $15 lock, the Building Management Company refused to give me a refund for those items or the $90 monthly storage fee.  They sighted the lease agreement I had signed, which makes them exempt from any liability due to theft or damage and said, "Accidents happen."  But this is no accident.  A day after my incident, the owners sent out an email to all the tenants acknowledging that "several of the units at City Center have had their locks cut off and the units have been entered by unknown persons."  Besides notifying the police, the owners are doing nothing to actually manage the property, and CERTAINLY nothing to show to their customers that they care and feel bad about the burglary incidents.  I'm writing this review to call out the Building Management Company, and warn other people about the burglar who likely will continue to break into these units unless more security, cleanliness, and signs of a human presence are enacted at City Center Storage, Charlottesville.  Any local business should treat customers better than I was treated.

reviews.text:
After renting here for 3 months it was easier to pack up all my things and move to a different storage company.

When attending to my storage unit for about 20min 3 or 5 days a week to minimize and organize my belongings I was constantly harassed by the man working on staff there. He is creepy and rude to say the least. I spoke with the owner about him and though he was kinder, he was general dismissive.

Things are perfect now at my new storage unit. Friendly staff, well lit inside and outside, clean, and better priced! I’m happy to give my money elsewhere to a place where I feel safe.

------------ UPDATE AND REPLY TO OWNER RESPONSE 5/15/2022 --------

This is classic "your word against mine" - To say that I broke a Virginia code for storage facilities is an utter false accusation. This company's response is an outright lie.

Not once did I ever sit, lay down, or sleep in this unit.  My unit was located right by the entrance and I did not feel comfortable having my things on full display for passerby's, this is why I would pull the door down while I organized to bring things to the Salvation Army. After I waited an hour to speak to the owner one morning, he apologized for how the front desk staff man behaved and told me not to pull the door all the way down for safety reasons (claiming some random person would come by and put a lock on my unit, while I was in there moving and filling boxes) - I did comply and didn't pull the door down again but instead I started to work on moving my things elsewhere. The owner did not talk to me about laying down or sleeping in the unit because it NEVER HAPPENED.

To point back to my initial complaint against this facility; I did not feel personally safe while at my unit or that my belongings were safe. I paid to have my items stored there and I used the unit according to the standards. I packed up all of my things and left on my own occurred because of the way they did business.

On two accessions, the front desk man, who I have had all the issues with, thought that I was someone else - I hope to God he was not again confusing me with another person and therefor making these baseless statements. Regardless, this business' lack of integrity is clear and I am glad I moved on.

If you are a women and especially a women of color I would advise you use another company for your storage needs.
I was well pleased with the safety and security of my possessions that were left in Woolen Mills Storage for seven + years. If need be I will use their facilities again. Thank you Eddie and crew.

Anytime I've had a question or problem all I've had to do is call they guys and they solve it right away. And so far, every problem I have had has been my fault.

5 stars, but only because I can't give them 6.
